1: -module(tls_SUITE).
    2: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
    3: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1, rsa_test/1, ecc_test/1, sm4_test/1]).
    4: 
    5: all() -> [rsa_test, ecc_test, sm4_test].
    6: 
    7: init_per_suite(Config) ->
    8:     CertDir = "/workspace/project/certs",
    9:     os:cmd("bash /workspace/project/scripts/gen_certs.sh " ++ CertDir),
   10:     ssl:start(),
   11:     [{cert_dir, CertDir} | Config].
   12: 
   13: end_per_suite(_Config) ->
   14:     ssl:stop().
   15: 
   16: rsa_test(Config) ->
   17:     CertDir = ?config(cert_dir, Config),
   18:     SslOpts = [
   19:         {certfile, filename:join(CertDir, "rsa_cert.pem")},
   20:         {keyfile, filename:join(CertDir, "rsa_key.pem")},
   21:         {versions, ['tlsv1.2']},
   22:         {ciphers, ["AES256-SHA256"]} %% RSA Key Exchange or similar
   23:     ],
   24:     test_handshake(9001, SslOpts, "-cipher AES256-SHA256", "AES256-SHA256").
   25: 
   26: ecc_test(Config) ->
   27:     CertDir = ?config(cert_dir, Config),
   28:     SslOpts = [
   29:         {certfile, filename:join(CertDir, "ecc_cert.pem")},
   30:         {keyfile, filename:join(CertDir, "ecc_key.pem")},
   31:         {versions, ['tlsv1.3']},
   32:         {ciphersuites, ["TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384"]}
   33:     ],
   34:     test_handshake(9002, SslOpts, "-ciphersuites TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384", "TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384").
   35: 
   36: sm4_test(Config) ->
   37:     case lists:member(sm4_cbc, crypto:supports(ciphers)) of
   38:         true ->
   39:             CertDir = ?config(cert_dir, Config),
   40:             SslOpts = [
   41:                 {certfile, filename:join(CertDir, "sm2_cert.pem")},
   42:                 {keyfile, filename:join(CertDir, "sm2_key.pem")},
   43:                 {versions, ['tlsv1.3']},
   44:                 {ciphersuites, ["TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3"]}
   45:             ],
   46:             test_handshake(9003, SslOpts, "-ciphersuites TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3", "TLS_SM4_GCM_SM3");
   47:         false ->
   48:             {skip, "SM4 not supported by this OTP/OpenSSL version"}
   49:     end.
   50: 
   51: test_handshake(Port, SslOpts, OpenSslArgs, ExpectedCipher) ->
   52:     {ok, ListenSocket} = tls_server:start(Port, SslOpts, self()),
   53:     receive
   54:         {server_started, _Pid} -> ok
   55:     after 2000 ->
   56:         error(timeout_waiting_for_server)
   57:     end,
   58:     
   59:     %% Run openssl s_client
   60:     Cmd = "echo 'Q' | openssl s_client -connect localhost:" ++ integer_to_list(Port) ++ " " ++ OpenSslArgs ++ " 2>&1",
   61:     Result = os:cmd(Cmd),
   62:     ct:log("OpenSSL Output: ~s", [Result]),
   63:     
   64:     tls_server:stop(ListenSocket),
   65:     
   66:     case string:find(Result, ExpectedCipher) of
   67:         nomatch -> 
   68:             ct:fail("Expected cipher ~s not found in handshake", [ExpectedCipher]);
   69:         _ -> 
   70:             ok
   71:     end.
